_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S9 UPPAbaby). UPPAbaby VISTA (single mode) — represented by the current VISTA V3; covers Vista/V2/V3 made 2015+. Uses CLEK'S OWN adapter for UPPAbaby. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: UPPAbaby VISTA V3 (single mode; covers Vista 2015+ / V2 / V3)

clekListed.clekRow: UPPAbaby Vista (Single Mode) — **Clek** car seat adapters for UPPAbaby; Upper: Car Seat Adapters for Vista & Cruz (0919-UMA-WW). Vista/V2/V3 made 2015-present only; not pre-2015.

specs._weightNote: Frame with toddler seat attached 27.6 lb (frame alone 19.8 lb, toddler seat 7.8 lb).
specs._foldNote: Folded with seat attached 16.3 x 25.7 x 33.8 in; folded without seat 11.3 x 25.7 x 32.3 in; self-standing.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth (included bassinet, or infant car seat via adapter, or lay-flat toddler seat)

recall.summary: UPPAbaby recalled ~71,000 units (CPSC, Jul 23 2015) covering the 2015 VISTA (Model 0101), 2015 CRUZ (Model 0181) and 2015 RumbleSeat: the foam bumper-bar cover is a choking hazard if a child bites off a piece. Remedy was a free bumper-bar cover and warning label. Applies to the 2015-model-year bumper bar (within this fragment's 'Vista 2015+' coverage); VISTA V2/V3 are not affected.

safety.notes: 5-point no-rethread harness; convertible single-to-double chassis; auto-lock fold; included bassinet from birth.

specs.foldType: one-piece fold with auto-lock, self-standing (folds with or without toddler seat)
specs.recline: multi-position reversible seat to fully lay-flat; bassinet included
specs.tires: never-flat foam-filled rubber-coated tires; all-wheel suspension; front swivel with lock

notes: Flagship full-size modular stroller; sourced from the current Vista V3, which represents the Clek-listed Vista/V2/V3. Clek compatibility applies only to units made 2015-present (not pre-2015). Single mode uses CLEK'S OWN 'Clek car seat adapters for UPPAbaby' upper adapter (adapter-clek-uppababy / UPPAbaby 0919-UMA-WW). Full-size and ~27.6 lb — the antithesis of the light/compact city goal, but a premium everyday/growing-family option. $999.99 MAP, in stock.
